name: Villamanín (Spain)
description: Five horizontal stripes of crimson, green, blue, green and crimson, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villamanín (a tower, an animal's head and a deer on red and blue).
history: Municipal flag of Villamanín; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
